briefdescription.para: Take a string identifier of a field being updated by op.

detaileddescription.para: All the error helpers below set diag with appropriate error code, taking into account field_no < 0, complex paths. They all return -1 to shorten error returning in a caller function to single line.

briefdescription.para: Update_field has a generic API and a typed API.

detaileddescription.para: The generic API takes fields of any type. These are: xrow_update_field_sizeof xrow_update_field_store xrow_update_op_do_field_<operation>
Typed API is used when type of an update_field is known in code, and by generic API internally. These are xrow_update_<type>_sizeof xrow_update_<type>_store xrow_update_op_do_<type>_<operation>

Sizeof calculates size of the whole subtree of a given update_field. Store saves the whole subtree. Operation executors apply an operation to one of the nodes in the subtree. They may change the update tree structure. Size of the updated field, including all children recursively.
